content: Provide an interface to retrieve the number of event memory entries Description: The diagnostic in AUTOSAR shall provide an interface to retrieve the number of event memory entries currently stored in Primary and user defined memories to the application. Additionally, the corresponding Client Server Interface shall be provided. Rationale: The interface is required from application, to check if event memory entries exist that influence the ECU behavior. Use Case: There is an application message where a status bit must be set as soon as events are stored in the event memory. Therefore, the application needs to know how many event memory entries exist. AppliesTo: CP, AP Dependencies: – Supporting Material: –
